## Reasoning

Every candidate harness in the pool carries the label "(no change)" in its diff. A direct comparison confirms: `harness.py`, `prompts/system.md`, and `prompts/task.md` are identical between `context/base_harness/` and every entry in `context/pool/`. 

All 9 rollouts (3 base + 6 candidates) delivered the identical correct answer `**Saturday**` with identical execution: 1 LLM call, ~1600–2500 tokens, zero divergence, zero failures. The adoption decision notes: "All three candidates are identical and correct... all are equally valid; A is selected arbitrarily."

Since no candidate made any edit to any component, there are no rows to write in the edits table. Since no edit produced any behavioral difference, and no trajectory shows a contrast between candidate and base, there is no execution evidence to support a durable lesson. The record shows only that a simple, already-correct harness remained unchanged across multiple rounds and continued to produce correct output.

This is not negative evidence—it is no evidence of an improvement opportunity. Per the mission, a lesson requires edit rows that establish a reusable operation. None exist here.
